steps.text: Half the raspberries (45/55 g) crushed with a fork and a squeeze of lemon, into the bottom of the bowl.
The rest of the raspberries (45/55 g) whole on top, then pumpkin seeds (10/13 g) and chia (6/8 g).

why: Crush half. A broken raspberry releases its acid into the yoghurt and does the job a spoonful of honey would otherwise be doing — the whole ones on top are there for the texture.
notes: No ruled defects or D0-003 substitutions apply. Tag corrected to 'fresh' per D0-013 already reflected in Phase 0 meals.json — no Sunday-batch draw, batchSource stays null. Entirely untimed no-cook assembly, consistent with the card's 2-minute chip.
